about: Pinned MCP tool descriptions and input schemas (FR-TOOL-5). Servers refuse to start when a SHA-256 below does not match. description_sha256 = sha256(UTF-8 description); input_schema_sha256 = sha256(canonical JSON of the schema file: sorted keys, no whitespace). After an intentional edit run: uv run python -m cohortex_mcp_common.manifest --write

tools.name: list_models
tools.title: List drive models
tools.description: Lists drive models in one dataset, from fleet-api. Returns data: a list of {model, media (hdd or ssd), capacity_bytes (bytes; null for alibaba), drive_count (drives on the model's latest day)}, largest drive_count first. Optional filters: media, and min_drives (latest drive_count at least this). Limits: at most 100 rows; results over 4 KB are split into pages (truncated, next_page; the page argument selects one). Example: {"source": "backblaze", "min_drives": 60}

tools.name: cohort_afr
tools.title: Cohort AFR series
tools.description: Annualized failure rate (AFR) of one drive model by period, from fleet-api. Returns data.series: one row per period (quarter YYYYQn or month YYYY-MM) with drive_days, failures, afr_pct and the exact Poisson 95% interval ci_low_pct to ci_high_pct. AFR is percent per year: afr_pct = failures x 365 x 100 / drive_days. Limits: the from..to window is inclusive and spans at most 8 calendar quarters; results over 4 KB are split into pages (truncated, next_page; the page argument selects one). Example: {"source": "backblaze", "model": "ST12000NM000J", "from": "2026-04-01", "to": "2026-06-30", "granularity": "quarter"}

tools.name: compare_cohorts
tools.title: Rank models by AFR
tools.description: Ranks the drive models of one dataset by AFR over a window, from fleet-api. Returns data.items: up to limit rows {model, drive_days, failures, afr_pct, ci_low_pct, ci_high_pct, rate_ratio_vs_fleet}, highest afr_pct first. AFR values are percent per year with exact Poisson 95% intervals; rate_ratio_vs_fleet is the model's AFR divided by the AFR of all models of the dataset in the window. A model qualifies when its drive_count on its last day in the window is at least min_drives (default 60). Limits: limit at most 20 (default 20); window inclusive, at most 8 calendar quarters; results over 4 KB are split into pages. Example: {"source": "backblaze", "from": "2026-01-01", "to": "2026-06-30", "min_drives": 60, "limit": 10}

tools.name: fleet_summary
tools.title: Fleet totals
tools.description: Totals for a whole dataset over a window, from fleet-api. Returns data with drives (distinct drives active in the window), drive_days, failures, afr_pct and the exact Poisson 95% interval ci_low_pct to ci_high_pct; AFR values are percent per year. Limits: window inclusive, at most 8 calendar quarters. Example: {"source": "backblaze", "from": "2026-04-01", "to": "2026-06-30"}

tools.name: smart_trend
tools.title: SMART attribute trend
tools.description: Trend of one SMART attribute's raw value for one drive model, from fleet-api. Returns data.series: one row per period with p50 and p95 of the raw value, nonzero_share (share of drive-days with a raw value above 0, from 0 to 1) and n_drives. Only drives in the 1% hash sample are included, so n_drives is the sample size, not the cohort size. attr is a kept attribute: backblaze 5, 9, 12, 187, 188, 193, 194, 197, 198, 199, 240, 241, 242; alibaba 5, 9, 12, 171, 172, 173, 174, 175, 187, 188, 194, 195, 199. Limits: window inclusive, at most 8 calendar quarters; results over 4 KB are split into pages. Example: {"source": "backblaze", "model": "ST12000NM000J", "attr": 197, "from": "2026-01-01", "to": "2026-06-30"}

tools.name: failed_drives
tools.title: Failed drives
tools.description: Drives of one model that failed inside a window, from fleet-api. Returns data.items: rows {drive_id, failed_on (date), age_days (days from first seen to failed_on), last_smart (SMART attribute id to raw value on failed_on)}, and data.total: failures in the window. Limits: at most 25 drives per page and 4 KB per result; the first 500 failures of the window can be paged; window inclusive, at most 8 calendar quarters. Example: {"source": "backblaze", "model": "ST12000NM000J", "from": "2026-04-01", "to": "2026-06-30", "page": 0}

tools.name: afr_ci
tools.title: AFR with exact Poisson interval
tools.description: Annualized failure rate with an exact Poisson confidence interval for one failure count. Returns data {afr_pct, ci_low_pct, ci_high_pct, confidence, method}; values are percent per year: afr_pct = failures x 365 x 100 / drive_days, interval from chi-square quantiles (lower bound 0 when failures is 0). method is exact_poisson_95 at confidence 0.95. Pure computation, no data access. Example: {"failures": 3, "drive_days": 98189, "confidence": 0.95}

tools.name: compare_rates
tools.title: Compare two failure rates
tools.description: Compares two failure rates with an exact conditional binomial test. Returns data {rate_ratio, ci_low, ci_high, p_value, method}: rate_ratio = (failures_a / drive_days_a) / (failures_b / drive_days_b), a unitless ratio; ci_low to ci_high is its 95% interval from the Clopper-Pearson interval; p_value is two-sided. rate_ratio and ci_high are null when unbounded (failures_b is 0). Needs at least one failure in total. Pure computation, no data access. Example: {"failures_a": 30, "drive_days_a": 1000000, "failures_b": 12, "drive_days_b": 1100000}

tools.name: change_point
tools.title: Failure-rate change point
tools.description: Finds the most likely single change in failure rate in a series of periods. Returns data {change_period (first period at the new rate; null when the series has no failures), change_index, statistic (likelihood-ratio statistic, 2 x log-likelihood gain), p_value, afr_before_pct, afr_after_pct (percent per year), rate_ratio (after / before; null when before is 0), n_points, bootstrap_draws, method}. The p-value comes from a parametric bootstrap under a constant rate (999 draws, fixed seed), so it is deterministic. Limits: 2 to 60 periods in time order. Pure computation, no data access. Example: {"series": [{"period": "2025Q3", "failures": 4, "drive_days": 90000}, {"period": "2025Q4", "failures": 5, "drive_days": 91000}, {"period": "2026Q1", "failures": 19, "drive_days": 90500}]}
